adaptation_disclosure: Hypotheses follow inspection of disclosed v3 OOF errors: four Ca FP (jsc1414,jsc1418,oreas170a,s3b); seven of nine FN in session2017-04-06; fold thresholds vary .003..999. No thresholds fit to these OOF labels.
outer_and_inner_partitions: Reuse exactly frozen v3 outer_fit/outer_validation and fit/calibrate/tune indices for each seed. No session/family/checksum/physical group crossing.

target.robust_success: Every one of the five seeds meets both point criteria; otherwise report individual/primary results without claiming robust success.

agreement_features: For each stage: mean/min/max log normalized excess and log SNR, within-stage disagreement; neutral-vs-ionized differences; counts SNR>=2,5,10. No sample identity or campaign/date feature.
calibration: Same fixed monotonic Platt ridge .001 on disjoint calibration groups; only known labels, equal physical weight, no class balancing.
threshold_rule: Tune max physical recall under FPR budget, ties lower FPR then higher threshold; unknown labels excluded even from threshold candidates.
candidate_selection: Tune max Ca recall, lower FPR, lower physical-weighted Brier, lower complexity then deterministic candidate ID. Report family-specific selectors and global selector. No outer result selects candidates or deployment.
all_attempts: Store scores and tuning diagnostics for all candidates and both budgets, and outer metrics of every fixed attempt; global primary uses budget.025.
uncertainty: Paired connected-cluster bootstrap of fixed matched OOF errors, 2000 resamples, 95% percentiles; conditional no refit; zero-error bootstrap not population bound. Per-seed counts plus mean/sampleSD describe split variability, not independent samples.
deployment: Original v3 non-Ca predictions retained. If numeric feature semantics change, separate safe calcium_adapter_v4 artifact; no silent v3 relabeling. No promotion solely because best outer result meets targets.
